authority.statement: This record prevents BBK documentation and examples from drifting from the supplied Blueprint plan. It does not create, amend, authorize, complete, or release a Blueprint capability.

interpretationRules: Current BBK-facing development references use the Effort Owner partition range C0 through C11, never C0 through C8.
The supplied normative Blueprint roadmap uses Q0 followed by C1 through C11.
BBK must not silently assert that Effort Owner partition C0 and normative roadmap identifier Q0 are the same semantic or authorization object.
Historical C1 through C8 references remain valid provenance and are interpreted through ADR-BP-131 and the successor compatibility map rather than rewritten.
C8 is the first complete Lite release candidate; C11 is the integrated Blueprint v1 qualification and release gate.

successorCapabilities.name: Adaptive execution, recovery, and Mission Control
Integrated Blueprint v1 qualification and release

topologyAssertionsAppliedToBBK: Root and Territory Wayfinders route clusters of human-decision work through a logical Questioning Wayfinder.
The Questioning Wayfinder prepares bounded context, owns branch parking/resumption/switching, validates structured returns, and delegates one focused decision branch to a Question Guide.
Logical responsibility, reusable procedure, and physical model/tool invocation remain distinct.
Context is routed explicitly; ambient transcript inheritance is not treated as authority.
Evidence exposure history is append-only and limits later claims of independence.
